title: Pretty pricey for the quality
text: Pretty pricey for the quality. I guess from the other reviews I was expecting something different. While these are nice they aren't exactly 'finest quality'. The pairs I received had a very rough feeling at the end where it would go in your mouth. I'm not a fan of splinters on my tongue. The box is nice but impractical for storage. I have had other laminated wood chopsticks that were better quality. They did clean easy but that isn't surprising with the lacquer finish.
